_comment: QuoteStream library. Add a title by dropping a new object into this array. type is 'movie' or 'series'. For a movie set `src` to the video path/URL. For a series add `seasons` with `episodes`. `poster`/`backdrop` are optional — leave them out and QuoteStream auto-generates a gradient poster from the title.

library.title: Big Buck Bunny
library.description: A big, good-natured rabbit is pushed too far by three bullying rodents and hatches a gentle, hilarious plan for payback. A Quote Library movie-night classic.

library.title: Sintel
library.description: A lonely young woman crosses a harsh world in search of the baby dragon she once nursed back to health. Streamed for the Sunday fantasy block.

library.title: Tears of Steel
library.description: In a future Amsterdam overrun by machines, a group of warriors and scientists gamble on one last plan to save the world.

library.title: Elephants Dream
library.description: Two strange characters explore a vast, ever-shifting machine and argue about what is really out there. The film that started open-source cinema.

library.title: For Bigger Adventures
library.description: A tiny short that got way too many replays in voice chat. You know the one.

library.title: The Quote Chronicles
library.description: The flagship watch-along series of The Quote Library — a rotating anthology of shorts the server binged together, episode by episode.
